title: Deep Foods / Chetak International — FDA Enforcement Intelligence
excerpt: Enforcement intelligence profile for Deep Foods LLC and its distribution arm Chetak LLC Group, covering 54 recall actions stemming from a massive Salmonella Anatum contamination event affecting 3.5 million+ bags of frozen Indian vegetables and fruits. The 2025 outbreak, traced to imported sprouted beans, triggered one of the largest Class I frozen food recalls in recent history and exposed critical FSVP gaps for ethnic food importers.
